models.name: The 35B
models.role: The borrowed brain that answers Aien and the agents today: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, a mixture-of-experts with about 3B parameters active per token, served by my own C GPU stack, built inside the Omega project with no NVIDIA user-space libraries. The Omega language does not reach the GPU yet. Track A works on its speed: every token should move at the speed of the memory bus.
